result.brief: 提出 Memory Forcing 流式少步视频生成方法，用 Archive & Working Banks 在固定 KV 缓存下保留中程历史，并用 Bank-aware RoPE 重分配时间索引，缓解中程遗忘，支持长视频与 5B 规模扩展。
result.reason: Autoregressive streaming video diffusion with KV-cache memory banks and bank-aware RoPE; directly advances long-video autoregressive generation and temporal memory for video world models.
